_meta.purpose: Single-source-of-truth snapshot: what is done, what is broken, what the plan is, in priority order. Read this before touching anything.

what_oracle_is.summary: Deterministic-at-the-core bug-bounty pipeline. Pull scope → recon → two LLM lenses + deterministic template engine → prove every candidate on the wire with a 5-gate verifier → synthesize a submission-ready PoC.
what_oracle_is.core_bet: The AI proposes, nothing is confirmed unless a code-only verifier sees a binary conflict proven on the wire.

committed_and_working: 5-gate deterministic verifier — refuses to confirm junk (proven: rejects benign /health)
Two LLM lenses: paradox (philosophy corpus + invisible seam) and mitre (full TTP + invisible seam)
Template engine reaches the wire (Bug B fixed, df59405) and carries machine-checkable predicates
Precision: info-disclosure requires real leak marker, not bare status 200 (0b03995)
Remaining templates given predicates + severity floor so low/info confirmations never auto-draft (4238a7f)
Recon tools installed: ffuf, katana, nuclei, subfinder, httpx, gau
12 platform sessions live (cookies persisted, 0600 security fix, 6ef9d3c)
Filter fix: max_reports no longer silently blocks non-HackerOne platforms (adcdeeb)
Verified precision on live app both directions: self-observing /debug/config CONFIRMS, /health REJECTS, artifact, open-redirect
not_verified_unproven: repulsive-gravity + deathless-hierarchy templates do not trigger on current fixture — UNTESTED
vacuum-identity TRUE positive untested (test app's access-control bug needs injected X-Original-Role header; template sends plain GET)
No end-to-end run on a real external program — all confirmed findings are on local app
Full loop (recon → analysis → verify → report) has never completed to a written report

blockers_to_real_submission.title: LLM seam cards always fail Gate 3 — _reflex_task() never asks for Expected: field
blockers_to_real_submission.detail: _reflex_task() asks for 'Reproducible check: curl -i -s [REAL URL]' but never requests 'Expected: status <NNN>[, body contains "<marker>"]'. Gate 3 at oracle_deterministic.py:587 rejects any card with expected["status"] is None. Every Engine A + Engine B output is dead on arrival on a real program.
blockers_to_real_submission.fix: Add '- Expected: status <NNN>[, body contains "<marker>"]' to the card template in _reflex_task(). Add HARD RULE 8: Expected field is mandatory and must include a status code.

blockers_to_real_submission.title: fuzzed_paths.txt is single-point-of-failure for all 11 template seam functions
blockers_to_real_submission.detail: All template functions read from fuzzed_paths.txt. 1 line = 0 candidates for most templates. For Phase A close: manually write the 7 test app routes. For real program: verify the scope gate for platform=direct passes 127.0.0.1:8765 before blaming ffuf.
blockers_to_real_submission.fix: Write correct fuzzed_paths.txt with all 10 test routes, re-run hunt 127.0.0.1:8765 --mindset seam --auto, confirm ≥3 CONFIRMED findings.

blockers_to_real_submission.title: Scope data never populated during listing pass — every platform except H1/YWH/Bugcrowd starts with structured_scopes: []
blockers_to_real_submission.detail: normalize_program_record() calls setdefault(structured_scopes, []). Scope-intake adapters only run during download_program_assets(), not during scraping. cmd_hunt with --auto-pick selects a program with empty scope. ProgramScopeGate built from empty scope is either vacuously open or blocks everything. Recon seed_hosts gets nothing.
blockers_to_real_submission.fix: Phase A: ensure scope download runs before hunt for any real program. Phase B+: wire _SCOPE_ADAPTERS into the listing pass OR enforce a mandatory intake step before hunt.

phase_A.name: Full philosophy coverage + close the loop on local test target
steps: Extract technique-shaped philosophies into moves + templates: Beautiful Liar (trust/validation, forged/invalid credential), Cliff and the Current (alternate-path auth), Invisible Architect (infrastructure seam)
Wire STANCE docs into system prompt as operating instructions: Pushing Physics, The Mind That Does Not Wait, Build the World
Clear verification debt: build fixture (or second test app) that triggers repulsive-gravity + deathless-hierarchy + vacuum-identity TRUE positive
Verify every move BOTH directions on live app via real run. Never from pytest or unit test passing status= directly.
DONE = every philosophy is a verified move or stance block; all templates pass both-ways; debt cleared

phase_B.name: First real-program run
steps: Pick one HackerOne web2 program: ≥$500, real JS+API, not picked-over (don't set max_reports; ignore patchstack's fake $15k)
Scope intake: oracle-hunter prescan --sync && oracle-hunter scan -N 1 --download
Triage CONFIRMED set: KEEP disclosure / access-control / IDOR / secret-exposure / logic; DROP header-only
Goal: one real, in-scope finding end-to-end

phase_C.name: Credentialed multi-step (ceiling raise)
steps: Make templates produce credentialed checks via the dual-account harness (oracle_auth_session.py:270)
Enables: IDOR, auth-bypass, role-escalation — the four-figure findings
Do after Phase B proves the base loop earns something real

phase_D.name: Volume + submit
steps: Fan out across many in-scope programs in parallel
Variant-sweep one confirmed bug across remaining assets → N reports
HUMAN reviews every PoC before sending — never auto-submit
Feed triage outcomes back into target selection + templates

web3_layer.decision: Build after Phase A closes. Engines (philosophy + MITRE) are domain-agnostic — zero changes needed there. Only target-specific layer differs.

verification_discipline.rule: Verify by RUNNING the real path, both directions, on the live app. A green test suite is not evidence (121 tests passed while the whole template path was silently blocked by Bug B). 'Looks done' has been wrong every time until a real run confirmed it.
verification_discipline.both_directions_means: benign endpoint REJECTS, real-finding endpoint CONFIRMS

guardrails: Submit only what the verifier CONFIRMED and a human eyeballed
Session cookies expire (days) — when a platform returns 0 programs, re-run save-cookies
Local-only testing until a real program is chosen — no scanning third-party infra without a named, in-scope target
HUMAN reviews every PoC before sending — never auto-submit
Template checks are plain GETs today (caps findings at disclosure/misconfig class). High-value IDOR/auth-bypass requires Phase C (credentialed checks)
